result.title: UA-Depth: Uncertainty-Aware Depth Restoration for Material-Agnostic Object Manipulation
result.summary: Robotic manipulation requires accurate metric depth, yet commodity RGB-D cameras often fail on non-Lambertian objects such as transparent, reflective, and translucent materials, producing holes, structured noise, and biased depth. Most restoration methods produce only a single depth map, treating noisy and reliable regions uniformly for downstream tasks while ignoring regional uncertainty. We present UA-Depth, an uncertainty-aware depth restoration framework that iteratively co-refines depth and pixel-wise uncertainty, and uses uncertainty-gated features to suppress unreliable cues for stable updates. To strengthen zero-shot behavior, UA-Depth leverages a frozen depth foundation model as a prior to initialize missing or unreliable depth, and applies two-stage MAD-weighted log-depth scale normalization to reduce outlier bias in relative-to-metric alignment. We introduce an eight-dataset zero-shot benchmark across diverse scenes, materials, and sensors. Across these benchmarks, UA-Depth achieves the best mean rank among representative baselines, with particularly strong gains on datasets dominated by transparent and reflective objects. Beyond depth metrics, we demonstrate downstream improvements in category-level 6D pose estimation and 6D grasp synthesis by exploiting the predicted uncertainty. \emph{Code, models, and data for training and evaluation will be released upon publication.}

AI.brief_summary: 提出 UA-Depth，一个在透明、反射、半透明材质下迭代联合精修深度与像素级不确定性的深度复原框架，用不确定性门控特征抑制不可靠线索，并借助冻结深度基础模型先验与两阶段尺度归一化提升零样本表现，还构建了八数据集零样本基准。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「状态与逐像素不确定性共同迭代更新、并在下游任务中使用不确定性」的做法，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、不可靠区域降权及基于置信度的停止决策提供可核查借鉴，但并非 latent 推理研究。
